title: error-handler-validation: validate_node_kind must check ErrorHandler.error_slot against slot_count
description: Bug S-22. vb_core::workflow/validation.rs:355-357 validate_node_kind does not check node.error_slot.is_some() => Some(slot) < slot_count for ErrorHandler nodes. The other 5 fields of CompiledNode are bounds-checked; error_slot is the only one not checked. The result: a workflow with ErrorHandler { error_slot: 99999 } and slot_count: 16 compiles successfully and crashes at runtime with a confusing SlotOutOfBounds. This bead adds a match arm for ErrorHandler in validate_node_kind that bounds-checks error_slot against slot_count.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL bounds-check every field of CompiledNode, including error_slot on ErrorHandler nodes
THE SYSTEM SHALL emit SlotOutOfBounds at compile time for an out-of-bounds error_slot, not at runtime

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a workflow has ErrorHandler { error_slot: 99999 } and slot_count: 16
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL fail to compile with SlotOutOfBounds, identifying the error_slot field

unwanted.condition: IF error_slot is None (no error slot)
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT emit SlotOutOfBounds; it must be a valid configuration
unwanted.because: ErrorHandler is optional; error_slot: None is the default and must be accepted

preconditions: Workflow compiles to a CompiledWorkflow with at least one ErrorHandler node
postconditions: Every CompiledNode field is bounds-checked at compile time
Out-of-bounds error_slot produces a typed SlotOutOfBounds error
invariants: validate_node_kind covers all 5 CompiledNode fields: input, output, next, error_slot, body

happy: error_handler_with_in_bounds_error_slot_compiles: a workflow with ErrorHandler { error_slot: SlotIdx(5) } and slot_count: 16 compiles successfully
error_handler_with_none_error_slot_compiles: a workflow with ErrorHandler { error_slot: None } compiles successfully
error: error_handler_with_out_of_bounds_error_slot_fails_with_slot_out_of_bounds: a workflow with ErrorHandler { error_slot: 99999 } and slot_count: 16 fails to compile with SlotOutOfBounds
error_handler_with_error_slot_equal_to_slot_count_fails: a workflow with ErrorHandler { error_slot: SlotIdx(16) } and slot_count: 16 fails (slot_count is exclusive upper bound)
edge: all_5_compiled_node_fields_are_bounds_checked: a proptest over 100 random CompiledNode configurations asserts all 5 fields are checked

files: crates/vb_core/src/workflow/types.rs (CompiledNode struct; 5 fields: input, output, next, error_slot, body)
patterns: Pattern: existing match arms for the other 5 fields (input, output, next, body) — copy the pattern for error_slot

security_failures.failure: An out-of-bounds error_slot causes a runtime panic, leaking memory contents in the panic message
security_failures.prevention: Bounds-check at compile time; emit typed SlotOutOfBounds, not a panic

usability_failures.failure: Workflow author gets a confusing runtime SlotOutOfBounds when the slot was statically wrong
usability_failures.prevention: Compile-time check; the error message includes the field name (error_slot) and the value (99999)

phase_0: Read crates/vb_core/src/workflow/types.rs to find the CompiledNode struct (5 fields)
phase_2: In validation.rs:355-357 validate_node_kind: add a match arm for ErrorHandler that bounds-checks error_slot against slot_count (if Some)
phase_3: Verify the other 4 fields are still bounds-checked (no regression)
phase_4: Run `moon run :test -p vb_core` and verify all new tests pass
Manual: `vb validate fixtures/error_handler_oob.yaml` should fail with SlotOutOfBounds naming error_slot

similar_implementations: Existing match arms for input, output, next, body (copy the pattern)

The slot_count parameter and how it's used

apis_that_exist: ValidationError::SlotOutOfBounds { field: &'static str, slot: SlotIdx, slot_count: u16 }
no_placeholder_values: Do NOT default error_slot to SlotIdx(0); it must remain Option<SlotIdx>
